evidence: common.schema.json UserInputPath (the type of ImportedEvidenceRecordV1.sourcePath) states in its own description: 'never enters any content identity; recorded in operational records only'. My v1 argument rested on a field the contract explicitly excludes from identity.

No join anywhere from sourcePath to wrapper.blobs. The only sourcePath joins (workflows_model.v1.py:765,775) belong to SourceMappingV1 and bind sourceSha256 to the SNAPSHOT INVENTORY, not to import blobs.

Payload custody is independent of blobs: registered_payload retains and re-hashes the canonical payload bytes and requires the exact registered schema DOCUMENT bytes. Those hold identically at zero blobs, so 'the payload cannot be re-derived' does not follow.
The archive-member rule is 'an archive member outside the wrapper's blobs is never read' - a restriction on READING, satisfied vacuously by an empty list; it does not mandate a member.
